landing.title: Healthy crops, higher yields, for every Indian farmer
landing.subtitle: Scan a leaf, talk to an AI assistant in your own language, and get treatments, weather, prices and markets — online and offline.
landing.feature1Body: Photograph a leaf and get the disease, severity and treatment in seconds.
landing.feature2Body: Voice-first support in Hindi and 11 more Indian languages.
landing.feature3Body: Keep scanning in the field — results sync when you're back online.
landing.feature4Body: Forecasts, disease-risk warnings and nearby outbreak alerts before they spread.
landing.feature5Body: Live mandi rates, price history and nearby markets so you sell at the right time.
landing.feature6Body: Sowing, watering and harvest reminders tuned to your field and your crop.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything a farm needs, in one app
landing.step1Body: Capture a leaf, fruit, stem or whole plant with your phone camera.
landing.step2Body: The AI identifies the disease, severity and stage in seconds — with a plain-language explanation.
landing.step3Body: Organic, chemical and homemade remedies, weather-aware advice and market prices.
landing.testimonial1Quote: Within minutes of scanning my tomato plants I caught early blight and saved the whole crop.
landing.testimonial2Quote: The app tells me what to spray and when — in my own language. It's my field diary and my calendar.
landing.ctaBody: Join farmers, experts and sellers building healthier farms across India.
